description: The March 12 CNL event is well supported as an actual same-site gathering of thousands and the ABP source records a request to the President, but both sources frame it as an ordinary party congress/anniversary ceremony. Whether this was a protest action, rather than a party meeting with a political speech, is unresolved under the supplied MM criteria.
required_followup: Independent scientific reviewer should assess whether the state-directed request was a demand made by the gathering and whether an ordinary CNL congress falls within the protest definition; keep eligibility pending until resolved.

description: Eleven actual rendered searches covered French, English and Kirundi, weekly windows 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, 22–31, local IWACU/RPA/ABP, regional and sector terms including Bujumbura, Gitega, Ngozi, Rumonge, Cibitoke, teachers, education, markets, fuel, labor and prices. Kirundi indexing returned mostly irrelevant results; open web only, without an equivalent historical newspaper archive. Search results include stale 2015-era matches.
required_followup: If further bounded coverage is assigned, search Kirundi-language local and regional outlet archives by each week and verify event dates against publication dates; avoid reusing stale results and February-onset events.

description: The actual March 12 CNL fourth-anniversary gathering may relate to the ceremony suspended for 19 February, but sources do not explicitly say that it was rescheduled. February excluded lead burundi_2023-02_X001 documents the earlier suspension.
required_followup: Retain separate actual dates and a possible-link record; only merge or reinterpret the February plan if a permitted source explicitly documents rescheduling.
